{{Quote|I developed the explosive slugs on Vatta Four, when I found myself without my blaster ''[&hellip;]'' All I could get my hands ''[sic]'' was a locally made slug thrower rifle (a Baed Sharpshooter, I think it was called).|Personal addendum by Airen Cracken, ''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide''|<ref name="CRFG" />}}
'''Vatta Four''' was a terrestrial celestial body<ref name="CRFG" /> located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space's]] [[Vatta system/Legends|Vatta system]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the local inhabitants of Vatta Four manufactured the type of [[Slugthrower rifle/Legends|slugthrower rifle]] known as the [[Baed Sharpshooter]].<ref name="CRFG" />

[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] visited the astronomical object at some point during that conflict. When a [[Hair trigger/Legends|modification]] Cracken had made to his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] had rendered it inoperable, the general, equipping himself with a Baed Sharpshooter, used [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]] from an [[Detonite charge/Legends|explosive charge]] he also had access to and created [[explosive slug]]s, a type of munition well-suited for penetrating the [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|armor]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. At some point following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Cracken described his visit to Vatta Four in ''[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide]]'', a [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] that documented various pieces of equipment utilized by Alliance agents.<ref name="CRFG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vatta Four was mentioned in the [[1991]] sourcebook [[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']], which was written by [[Christopher Kubasik]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="CRFG" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Vatta [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Vatta Four, in grid square M-21.<ref name="TEA" />
